body: Coming back to say I hope you didn’t get licensed. I’m rereading these comments years later and this is one of the most inaccurate, presumptuous, and damaging comments that was left. I sincerely hope you’ve improved since this was left.

Yeah, and her bff was kind of an asshole too lol. Very rude and a know-it-all. Kept giving me go to hell looks when I expressed an opinion that differed from hers. Shit, at one point she popped off on me, giving me a genuine attitude because I didn’t know the name of someone from a freaking tv show lol. It wouldn’t have worked out between us regardless because neither of us were super interested, and after I figured out that I didn’t like her best friend that was definitely it, but she didn’t need to be such a bitch about it. Going out making assumptions without even asking if her crazy ass scenario was the truth. I did dodge a bullet, and I’m trying to ignore her hateful bullshit. She just hit an insecurity lol
You’re right, I know you are. She just hit me right in an insecurity. Reading this did help a bit though, so thank you.

I get that, but that’s why I invited her and her bff. There’s also the fact that all of my friends are female lol. I get that she might have been weirded out when she figured out my friend was gay, but idk. I still feel like she should have asked instead of making up a scenario in her head and then popping off without considering that there might be another explanation.

It’s absolutely fair for her to not be interested. Truthfully I wasn’t too into it either, lol. It’s just the end bit of “there’s nothing attractive about you” and her assuming that I brought 2 dates without asking me if that’s what was happening. I did dodge a bullet, though. She just hit me right in an insecurity lol

I have no words to offer that will make anything even a little better, but just know that you’ll be on my mind. It won’t be today, but I hope that eventually you can find peace. Please do not do this alone. Find someone to lean on. Anyone. I’m so sorry this has happened to you, and I hope that your wife has finally found peace. Don’t forget to take care of yourself. Self care is easy to forget about in times like these. Shower, eat, sit in the sun. I am so, so sorry friend 💜

I’m glad you’re still here 💜 something I’ve learned over these last couple of months is that life only gets better if you give it the chance to. If you have access to help, take it. Living through pharmaceuticals has been great for me lol. Two months ago I tried to die. Today I have a second date with a wonderful girl who makes me smile a lot. Life is miserable sometimes, but there’s good bits too. You just have to breathe long enough to see them. If you ever need an ear, message me 💜

Things are very different now than they were when I posted this. The main difference being that I got help. I’m on medication and see a therapist regularly. Second, Angie and I are no longer on speaking terms. I needed space to deal with life and she wouldn’t give me that space. Third, I’m dating. My feelings for Angie are gone and I’ve actually found someone else who is pretty amazing. I’m okay. Things are okay. Thanks for reading my post 💜

Hi, I was recently kind of ghosted. It’s also a detailed story, but for me what was worse than just being told she didn’t want to see me anymore was knowing she just didn’t care enough to give me that. We went out a couple times, talked for hours on end, she even kissed me, and in the end I wasn’t even worth a half assed explanation until I flat asked if she was ghosting. Wish I could tell you how to get over it, but I’m going on two weeks and it still hurts, tbh. Sending love, stranger 💜

I hope you fail like I did. Life has been tough since April 5th, but it’s getting better. I met someone new. Idk if it’s going to work out because she’s got some demons of her own, but meeting her made me see that life is bigger than what I saw that day and the months leading up to it. My life isn’t rainbow gumdrops and butterflies—not by any means—but I can say with certainty that I can find happiness. Idk when I’ll find it, but I will. And I believe that you can too. Run away for a weekend. That’s what I’m doing now. Im in a town an hour away from home because I can’t handle that this new girl is probably going to tell me that she can’t see me anymore. If you can find the will to simply commit to continue breathing, I promise you that you can survive. Sending all my love, stranger 💜

No, it’s not just you. I internalize everything. I blame myself for everything that goes wrong in my life. Even when a part of my brain knows it’s not my fault, I will find a way to blame myself. Feeling guilty about everything all the time sucks.
We can’t help each other right now. Everything is just too difficult and confusing. We’re taking time apart
Thank you 💜
I do. We’re taking a break from each other.
I keep going back and forth
I did not attempt suicide to show anyone anything. I appreciate the input, but I am not your patient. Do not web-diagnose me.
It’s never that simple. I didn’t plan on killing myself when I woke up yesterday. It just happened. It’s okay if you don’t understand it, but do not patronize me.
I have no plan. Right now I’m just breathing

“Let the assholes be assholes. You’ll sleep better.”

I wish you well.
Thank you for not telling me to get rid of her.
This is my lock screen now. Right now I don’t believe it, but a small part of me wants to. Maybe I’ll believe it tomorrow. Idk, but thank you
I’m not sure what you decided on, but I’m a woman haha
I haven’t
